page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a large woodcut initial. Above the text: the title of the work in two lines, then the name heading. Two marginal notes in the right margin. Page number at top right. Signature at foot.

main_text.l: tenebris occupatæ, à Deo revocari ac restitui cœpit.

l.i: ETsi hæc misera & diuturna conditio professióque
fuerit eorum, qui Christiani sunt appellati, ut ipsum
nudum Christi nomen tantummodo habuerint, sum-
maque ingratitudine se vera salutarique doctrina
priuauerint: nulla tamen tanta hominum ingratitudo &
impietas unquam potuit ita bonitatem Dei superare, quin is sem-
per aliquod piorum semen conseruarit, ex quo Ecclesia propagari, a-
missamque religionem recuperare ac retinere posset. Et quanvis nul-
lus fuit orbis angulus, qui non densissimis ac teterrimis ignorantiæ te-
nebris oppressus extiterit: tamen Deus semper ad illuminandā atque
illustrandam veritatem, aliquas scintillas conseruauit ac suscitauit, pro
ea temporis ratione quam opportunam suæque iustitiæ ac nostræ saluti
accommodatam iudicauit. Quum autem multa & certa & clara sunt
signa, & illustria testimonia, quæ hanc Euangelij doctrinam, his tem-
poribus renouatam ac restitutam declarant puram esse Dei veritatem,
in qua sit saluberrimus animorum pastus, ad vitam alens sempiternam:
tum vero illud minimè obscurum aut dubium, quod multi Martyres ac
testes eius non dubitant pro ea confirmanda tuendaque sanguinem su-
um usque etiam ultimam guttam profundere: atque ita declarare
quanta sit misericordia eius, qui nos perditos ac iacentes in horrendis
mortis tenebris, ad hanc salutarem Euangelij lucem, suæque voluntatis
agnitionem revocarit. Hanc autem veritatem Dei esse, illud maximè
demonstrat, quod nulla fuit ætas, in qua Satan omni odio furiosissimo
hanc Euangelij doctrinam persequutus non fuerit, & conatus eam o-

marginalia.note: Semen Martyrum à Deo seruatum ad Ecclesiæ suæ conseruationem.

page.notes: Drop cap "E" is a woodcut initial, read as E joined to "Tsi". The word "hæc" is printed as a ligature, read as hæc. The name line "Vicleff" ends in a long-s form printed as ff; transcribed as Vvicless, please check. The word "salutarique" is faint and may be read differently. The last word "o-" is broken at the foot of the page and continues on the next page. The text is set in italic throughout; roman words such as Deus and Dei could not be separated with certainty. The note "Semen Martyrum" is split as "Mart-/yrum" in print and transcribed whole. The page has no running head, as it opens the work.
